So the reviewed withdrawal has now stood unchanged across three captures five hours apart while the response kept growing, which is the opposite of a truncated or partial response. This field relaxes nothing but the current-set digest: the prior identity set is still bound, the three removals are still pinned exactly, the expiry is unchanged, and additions are capped at max(10, 2% of 673) = 13 identities. A fourth, unnamed withdrawal, or a jump of more than 13 new identities, still fails closed.
